text: I'm Frank Edwards, and I'm a host.
Mr. Edwards, our guest tonight is Major Donald E. Kehoe, U.S. Marine Corps retired,
a veteran of 35 years of civilian and military flying experience.
Major Kehoe was paid to Colonel Charles Lindbergh on Lindy's tour of the country
after the historic transplanted flight.
A well-known aviation writer, in 1930, Major Kehoe brought out his bestseller,
flying saucers are real, which showed up a real tempest.
And in 1953, another bestseller, Flying Saucers from Outer Space,
books based on material from Air Force and Canadian official sources.
Major Kehoe, what are the most recent developments in this field of unidentified flying objects?
There are three very important developments which have been kept from the public.
In the first place, there is at least one, and possibly two, artificial satellites circling
the Earth at the present time.
An intensive effort is being made by government scientists at Western New Mexico to locate
and charge the courses of these satellites in an effort to determine what they are and
where they came from.

The third development we present kept secret is this.
In the closing week of March, the Air Force Secretary Talbot made two trips to Palm Springs,
California in an Air Force plane.
On one of those trips, shortly after the plane had passed Fresno, California, the crew of
Secretary Talbot's plane discovered that it was being followed by a large silvery disc-shaped
about 1,000 feet below the Secretary's plane and about 1,000 feet distance.
The unidentified object was seen by Secretary Talbot, the crew of the plane,
and Secretary Talbot's aide, who accompanied him on the trip.
After watching the disc for several minutes,
Secretary Talbot ordered his plane to swing around and approach him.
The object immediately accelerated and disappeared at high speed.
This was a daylight sighting of long duration by credible personnel
and under very favorable conditions.
In view of the tremendous amount of evidence that is being concealed by airport secrecy,
in the nighttime the American people demanded a notification.
Thank you very much. Major Donald E. Kehoe, U.S. Marine Corps, retired.
